artifact_hash_note: Hashes are observations at collection time; only completed attempt artifacts are immutable result evidence.

interpretation.cg_certificate: Only certified_rc_optimal=true with exact_nonnegative_reduced_cost and zero artificial weight certifies the full conservative event-time/SOC covering LP for that case.
interpretation.integer_proof: The dedicated two-stage MIP proves only its saved finite capacity-aware pool; fleet and charging-cost stages are reported separately.
interpretation.interrupted_pricing: pricing_deadline has null terminal exact reduced cost and is never a pricing certificate; the last atomically accepted pool remains usable evidence.
interpretation.physical_validation: Selected routes require individual replay plus the continuous half-open shared-capacity sweep for capacity arms.
interpretation.physics_scope: The 236.44/35.466 cells test confirmed usable energy and 15% reserve in the constant-rate event model. They do not implement or claim the nonlinear 18E1 charging curve.
interpretation.selector_equivalence: Claim selector equivalence only for matched cases with equal exact terminal status and normalized capacity-aware routes; time-censored progress is descriptive.
interpretation.terminal_target: No 65% terminal floor or target is imposed or inferred.
